# Tools

<!-- Generated by `pnpm api:generate` from the tools' schemas: do not edit. -->

Every tool the Extrudo MCP server lists, with its inputs. Tools marked
**changes the design** run as one undo step named `Agent: …` and answer the
features whose status is `error` or `warning` after the recompute (`problems`).

## `list_designs`

Lists the designs (id, name, last change); "open" marks the one open now.

No inputs.

## `new_design`

Makes a new empty design, opens it and answers it as get_design does.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | no | The design's name. |

## `open_design`

Opens a design by id (from list_designs) and waits until it is ready.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The design id. |

## `get_design`

The open design: id, name, parameters, configurations, and the timeline as [{ id, type, name, status, message?, suppressed }]. Read it first, and after every change: status 'error' or 'warning' says what went wrong.

No inputs.

## `get_document`

The open design's whole document JSON (the file format's document).

No inputs.

## `get_feature`

One feature: its type, name, status and inputs as the API's plain values (what add_feature and edit_feature take); a sketch lists its plane, frame (world mm), profiles, regions (each profile's area, box, centroid and loops, as add_sketch answers them) and curves with their reference { kind: 'sketchEntity', id: '<sketch id>/<curve id>' } (a revolve's axis takes one; an extrude's side face of curve <c> is side:<c>).

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The feature id. |

## `get_bodies`

The bodies at the timeline marker: [{ id, name, color?, opacity?, volume (mm³), box ({ min, max } in mm), visible }]. The id (<feature id>:<n>) is what a body reference takes.

No inputs.

## `check_interference`

Finds bodies that overlap: [{ a, b, volume (mm³), box ({ min, max } mm) }], one entry per pair that shares volume; [] when none do. Touching faces don't count. Run it before finishing a model of several bodies: overlapping bodies print badly. Changes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bodies` | `({ kind: string, id: string })[]` | no | The bodies to check against each other (references); all visible bodies when left out. |

## `get_selection`

What the person has selected in the app: [{ kind, id }].

No inputs.

## `screenshot`

A picture of the model as a PNG, framed on the bodies, drawn apart from the person's view (which doesn't move). Without inputs: the app's current view direction, sketches and construction shown, 768 px. Inputs pick another side, only some bodies (framed on them), a section that cuts away what lies past a plane (a floor plan: view 'top', section on 'xy' at the floor's height), and the size. Sizes come from get_bodies, not pictures. At most one per second.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `view` | `"iso" \| "top" \| "bottom" \| "front" \| "back" \| "left" \| "right" \| [number, number, number]` | no | Where to look from: 'iso', 'top', 'bottom', 'front', 'back', 'left', 'right', or [x, y, z], the direction from the model to the camera. |
| `bodies` | `({ kind: string, id: string })[]` | no | Only these bodies (references, ids from get_bodies), framed on them. |
| `section` | `{ plane: "xy" \| "xz" \| "yz" \| { kind: string, id: string }, offset?: number \| string }` | no | Cuts away everything on the side the plane's normal points to (above an 'xy' plane). |
| `overlays` | `boolean` | no | Sketches and construction geometry; default true. |
| `size` | `integer` | no | Width and height in px; default 768. |

## `list_commands`

The app's commands run_command takes: [{ id, label, group, unavailable? }].

No inputs.

## `set_parameter`

**Changes the design.**

Sets a parameter to an expression, or creates it when no parameter has that name. Sketches re-solve. One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The parameter's name, e.g. width. |
| `expression` | `string` | yes | Its expression with a unit, e.g. '40 mm' or 'width * 2'. |

## `apply_configuration`

**Changes the design.**

Applies a configuration (by id or name): its parameters take the configuration's values.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `configuration` | `string` | yes | The configuration id or name. |

## `add_sketch`

**Changes the design.**

Adds a sketch on a plane with the shapes given and answers its id, its profiles (the references an extrude's profiles take) and regions: per profile, in the same order, { profile, area (mm²), box and centroid (sketch mm), outer and holes (curve ids), shapes (indices of the shapes bounding it) }, to tell a ring from the hole inside it, and frame: { origin, xDir, yDir, normal } in world mm, where sketch x and y go (a one-side extrude goes along normal). Plane: 'xy', 'xz', 'yz', a construction plane { kind: 'plane', id: '<feature id>' } or a planar face reference. One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plane` | `"xy" \| "xz" \| "yz" \| { kind: string, id: string }` | yes | 'xy', 'xz' or 'yz' (the origin planes), a construction plane { kind: 'plane', id: '<feature id>' } (offsetPlane, …) or a planar face reference. |
| `shapes` | `shape[]` | yes | What to draw: objects whose `shape` names the kind (rectangle, circle, …). |
| `name` | `string` | no | A name for the sketch. |

Each shape is an object whose `shape` names its kind, with that kind's fields:

- `{ "shape": "rectangle", "from": [number, number], "to": [number, number], "width"?: string | number, "height"?: string | number }` — A rectangle from two opposite corners, optionally dimensioned.
- `{ "shape": "centeredRectangle", "center": [number, number], "corner": [number, number], "width"?: string | number, "height"?: string | number }` — A rectangle from its centre and one corner, optionally dimensioned.
- `{ "shape": "circle", "center": [number, number], "diameter": string | number }` — A circle with a diameter dimension.
- `{ "shape": "line", "from": [number, number], "to": [number, number] }` — A line.
- `{ "shape": "polyline", "points": ([number, number])[], "closed"?: boolean }` — Lines joined end to end; closed joins the last point to the first.
- `{ "shape": "arc", "start": [number, number], "end": [number, number], "through": [number, number] }` — An arc from start to end through a third point.
- `{ "shape": "slot", "from": [number, number], "to": [number, number], "width": number }` — A slot between two centres, width in mm.

## `add_feature`

**Changes the design.**

Adds a feature at the timeline marker through the document API: type is the API method's feature type ('extrude', 'box', 'fillet', …) and inputs its plain values (see the skill's references/api.md); { edgeBetween: [faceName, faceName] } names the edge between two faces. A bad input answers the input's path and changes nothing. One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | yes | The feature type, e.g. 'extrude'. |
| `inputs` | `object` | default `{}` | The method's inputs. |
| `name` | `string` | no | A name for the feature. |

## `edit_feature`

**Changes the design.**

Changes some inputs of a feature (the API's plain values, as add_feature). Inputs not named keep their values. One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The feature id. |
| `inputs` | `object` | yes | The inputs to change. |

## `set_body_appearance`

**Changes the design.**

Changes how a body looks: its colour, opacity, name and whether it is shown. Inputs not given keep their values. One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The body's id from get_bodies (<feature id>:<n>), or a feature id that made one body. |
| `color` | `string` | no | Its colour, '#rrggbb'. |
| `opacity` | `number` | no | 0.1 (nearly clear) to 1 (opaque). |
| `name` | `string` | no | The body's name. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | no | Shown (true) or hidden (false). |

## `suppress`

**Changes the design.**

Suppresses a feature (on: true) or brings it back (on: false). One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The feature id. |
| `on` | `boolean` | default `true` |  |

## `rename`

**Changes the design.**

Renames a feature. One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The feature id. |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |

## `remove`

**Changes the design.**

Deletes a feature; refused while another feature uses it. One undo step.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The feature id. |

## `run_command`

**Changes the design.**

Runs one of the app's commands by id (list_commands lists them). One that opens a dialog or a sketch answers `opened`: it is finished in the app, and change tools are refused until then.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The command id. |

## `undo`

**Changes the design.**

Undoes the last change (an agent change is one step).

No inputs.

## `redo`

**Changes the design.**

Redoes the change undo took back.

No inputs.

## `save`

Saves the open design now (it also saves itself).

No inputs.

## `export`

Exports the visible bodies as STL, 3MF or STEP. Extrudo writes the file and answers its path. At most one every 2 s, 20 MB at most.

| Input | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `"stl" \| "3mf" \| "step"` | yes |  |

## `get_skill`

The Extrudo skill's SKILL.md: how to model in Extrudo with these tools.

No inputs.
